summary: Frontend-only verification of the ProjectDetail workspace_id race-condition fix (WS_HOLDER removal). Race condition is FIXED: every /api/analytics/breakdown request fired from the Project Detail page now includes a valid workspace_id (never null/empty) and only fires after both projectId and workspaceId are known. Verified on initial click-through, on a direct hard-load of /projects/<id>, and on Projects->back->reopen. pd-spend/pd-requests/pd-success/pd-latency/pd-model/pd-workflow test-ids all render. API Keys tab regression still works. However, on this run the scoped Overview KPIs render as '—' / '0%' and both breakdown cards render 'No data in this range.' even though the requests succeed (2xx) with the correct workspace_id — appears to be a data-freshness/seeding issue (seeded events likely outside the hardcoded 30d window), NOT the race-condition fix. Main agent should re-seed demo data or widen the range, then re-verify real values populate.

integration_issues.issue: Overview KPIs show '—'/'0%' and breakdown cards show 'No data in this range.' despite breakdown/overview requests returning 2xx with valid workspace_id+project_id and range=30d. Likely demo seed events are older than 30 days now (Jan 2026 wall clock vs. iteration_2 seed which showed $43.90/2017 req on Last 30d). Race-condition fix is unrelated — this is data-freshness.

verified_working: Projects list -> click 'Demo Production App' -> /projects/<id> (Overview tab default)
All /api/analytics/breakdown requests observed on Project Detail contain valid workspace_id (a9bfc95d-...) AND project_id (1b992369-...). Never null, never empty, never missing.
Direct hard-reload of /projects/<id> also fires breakdown requests only with valid workspace_id (fix confirmed under the actual race scenario).
Projects -> back -> reopen 'Demo Production App' fires fresh breakdown requests with correct workspace_id (no stale/leaked value).
pd-model and pd-workflow BreakdownCards render with data-testid; pd-spend/pd-requests/pd-success/pd-latency StatCards render.
API Keys tab still opens; api-keys-table renders (regression check).
critical_code_review_comments: useScoped guard `if (!projectId || !workspaceId) return;` + `[path, projectId, workspaceId]` deps correctly gate the request. Fix looks clean.

ProjectDetail hardcodes range='30d' for both /analytics/overview and /analytics/breakdown, ignoring the header range-select. Consider threading the global range so users can see wider windows if seed data is old.
action_items: Verify demo data freshness: seeded events may now be >30 days old. Re-run Seed Demo Data (or extend the demo seeder to backfill relative to today) so Project Detail Overview + breakdown cards show non-empty rows on the default 30d window.
Optional: honour the header range on Project Detail scoped queries instead of hardcoding 30d.

success_rate.frontend: Race-condition fix: 100% verified. Data population on Project Detail: 0% (empty due to data-freshness, not the fix).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The WS_HOLDER race fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/ProjectDetail.js is verified. If Overview/breakdown cards still show '—' / 'No data in this range.' on Project Detail, the culprit is stale demo seed data relative to today's date, NOT the race-condition fix — re-seed and retest. workspace_id for founder = a9bfc95d-65e2-4daa-91e0-d397d1d07fed; Demo project id = 1b992369-9d5b-4a1c-825d-d0a1b7ac3c1e.
rca_of_the_issue: Race-condition RCA (from problem statement): a module-level WS_HOLDER mutable object was used to smuggle workspaceId into useScoped, so on first render (before /projects/{id} resolved) useScoped fired /analytics/breakdown with workspace_id=null (or a stale value from a prior project view). Fix: pass workspaceId explicitly through props (ProjectDetail -> ScopedOverview -> useScoped) and early-return when either id is missing; include workspaceId in the effect deps so the request refires once it arrives. Verified via network capture: zero requests without a valid workspace_id across initial click, hard-reload, and back+reopen flows.
